crossRefs.note: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might…
They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with…
So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.
Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,
whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of…
Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger…
He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.
Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross, and come after me, can’t be my disciple.

people.name: Cyrene
people.line: City in North Africa; home of early Christians

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Simon
people.line: A man who carried Jesus' cross on the way to crucifixion.

translations.web: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid on him the cross, to carry it after Jesus.
translations.bsb: As the soldiers led Him away, they seized Simon of Cyrene on his way in from the country, and they put the cross on him to carry behind Jesus.
translations.kjv: And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus.
translations.asv: And when they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid on him the cross, to bear it after Jesus.
